summary.name: Chime
summary.one_liner: Chime is an open source code editor for macOS that focuses on a minimalist UI and Language Server Protocol support.
use_cases: editing source code on a Mac
writing Go or other programming languages
project-aware code editing with language servers
extending an editor with native plugins
summary.what_it_does: Chime is described as an open source editor for macOS, designed to be a native Mac application. Its UI is minimalist and built around focus. It supports the Language Server Protocol, and extensions can offer deeper project integration. The page says its extensions are also native. The page shows a Go code sample but does not list specific editing features beyond these claims.
caveats: Page does not state a license or pricing details beyond 'open source'
Only macOS is named as a platform
Page content is light on specific features
